jobDescription:
We're looking for a Sr. Technical Project Manager to join our team.

About us
Amantra is a technology-driven company focused on building innovative digital solutions and next-generation products for global clients. We specialize in delivering scalable technology solutions across industries while continuously exploring emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), automation, and advanced digital platforms. With a growing international presence, Amantra works with clients across Middle East, Europe, and the United States, helping businesses transform their operations through technology. Our team is committed to innovation, collaboration, and delivering high-quality solutions that create real business impact. The Technical Project Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end delivery of customer-facing projects and professional services engagements. The ideal candidate should possess a strong blend of software development experience and project management expertise, enabling them to effectively communicate with engineering teams, customers, and leadership stakeholders. Candidates with prior experience in product-based organizations, particularly those involved in AI/ML product development and delivery, will be highly preferred.

Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of multiple projects and customer engagements.
- Define project scope, timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and delivery plans.
- Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and quality expectations.
- Drive project governance, status reporting, risk management, and escalation handling.
- Act as the primary liaison between customers, business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams.
- Conduct regular project reviews, steering committee meetings, and status updates.
- Manage customer expectations and ensure high levels of client satisfaction.
- Collaborate closely with engineering teams to understand technical challenges and delivery dependencies.
- Review solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation plans from a project delivery perspective.
- Facilitate technical discussions and translate business requirements into actionable execution plans.
- Lead implementation, customization, integration, and deployment initiatives for enterprise customers.
- Coordinate with customer teams during onboarding, deployment, UAT, and go-live activities.
- Ensure successful adoption of products and smooth transition to support and operations teams.
- Manage delivery of AI/ML-based products and solutions.
- Coordinate with Data Science, Engineering, Product, and QA teams to ensure successful execution of AI initiatives.
- Track AI project lifecycle, model deployment milestones, performance metrics, and customer deliverables.
- Establish and improve project management processes, delivery frameworks, and best practices.
- Drive Agile/Scrum methodologies and ensure continuous process optimization.
- Monitor project KPIs and delivery metrics.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 8-10 years of overall experience with a strong mix of:
- Software Development/Engineering experience.
- Technical Project Management experience.
- Proven experience managing enterprise software implementation and delivery projects.
- Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
- Experience managing cross-functional teams including Engineering, QA, Product, and Customer Success.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
- Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience working in a Product-Based Technology Company.
- Prior experience delivering Agentic AI, AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Analytics, or Intelligent Automation projects.
- Understanding of APIs, integrations, microservices architecture, and modern software development practices.
- PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project management certifications are advantageous.
- Experience managing global customers and distributed teams.

How to Apply
- Interested candidates can share their cv at careers@amantra.ai
